mapper.insert: INSERT INTO charge_history_tb(user_id, order_Name, order_id, point, total_amount, approved_at, method, payment_key, refund_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderName}, #{orderId}, #{point}, #{totalAmount}, #{approvedAt}, #{method}, #{paymentKey}, 'none')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tb SET point = point + #{point} WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_tb SET point = point - #{point} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM charge_history_tb WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO refund_tb(payment_key, order_name, order_id, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, requested_at, canceled_at, cancel_status) VALUES
(#{paymentKey}, #{orderName}, #{orderId}, #{cancel.cancelAmount}, #{cancel.cancelReason}, #{requestedAt}, #{cancel.canceledAt}, #{cancel.cancelStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE charge_history_tb SET refund_status = #{refundStatus} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, c.id AS chargeHistoryId, c.order_name AS orderName, c.order_id AS orderId, c.total_amount AS cancelAmount, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.request_at AS requestAt, c.refund_status AS refundStatus FROM request_refund_tb AS r JOIN charge_history_tb AS c ON r.charge_history_id = c.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM request_refund_tb
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_refuse_tb(charge_history_id, refund_refuse_reason, created_at) VALUES (#{chargeHistoryId}, #{refundRefuseReason}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM charge_history_tb) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(cancel_amount), 0) FROM refund_tb) AS revenue
